scope: editor-side material, rendering, terrain, and model authoring
implemented: materialEdit captures typed importer pre-state, verifies native or importer read-back, and restores the previous property on postcondition failure.
materialValidate verifies material asset identity plus native query-material and importer property availability.
renderConfigurationApply applies bounded scene property updates with snapshot, read-back, and rollback failure typing.
renderDiagnosticsCollect exposes bounded editor-side render pipeline diagnostics and explicitly reports runtimeSampling=false.
terrainEdit is a typed version-gated adapter and fails closed when Creator 3.7.3 has no supported persistent terrain height/layer write API.
modelImportConfigure has a typed schema and delegates to importer reimport/read-back; modelImportInspect and modelImportValidate expose typed settings and imported sub-asset output checks.
observableContracts: Material mutations are verified through native material or importer settings read-back and rollback is attempted after mutation failures.
Rendering configuration is editor-side scene property mutation only; no runtime visual proof is claimed.
Terrain mutation returns UNSUPPORTED_EDITOR_API 422 rather than pretending persistence when no native write API is exposed.
Model importer configure uses typed importer descriptors, reimport, and read-back; inspect/validate report bounded sub-asset outputs.
blocked: Creator 3.7.3 terrain height/layer write API is not exposed; terrainEdit remains fail-closed until a version-gated native route exists.
Runtime frame sampling and rendered visual comparisons remain deferred by scope.
